data.script: Mateo: Sports day, live! First race: one hundred metres. … Mateo: Sofia runs like the wind… and wins! Green team, five points. … Mateo: Now the high jump. Erik jumps… one metre ten! … Mateo: The ball race: Valentina throws, I catch… oops, I dropped it. Blue team laughs. … Mateo: But Luna catches the next one IN THE AIR. The crowd goes crazy! … Mateo: Final score: green twenty, blue eighteen. … Sofia: And everyone gets ice cream, because on sports day everybody wins something!
